text:
lee: heads-up: migration job attempted last night but several nodes reported vault-unseal timeouts. proposing a migration heartbeat gate to avoid RBAC drift during rolling restarts.
anya: +1. we had at least two incidents where RBAC hardening didn't land because the migration ran when control-plane connectivity was flaky.
frank: concrete idea: migration job emits `migration_heartbeat{node="..."}=1` only if it can reach vault-unseal and audit-forwarder egress. Rolling restart CI will query that metric and abort if any node reports 0.
netbot: network note: a BGP flap could make vault-unseal unreachable for ~2-5m; require heartbeat check window of 10m to avoid flapping aborts.
anya: also add preflight checks: 1) vault health unsealed 2) `audit-forwarder` can reach retention endpoint (test TLS handshake) 3) keystore-agent can list /v1/sys/audit, and 4) node netpols allow egress to vault-unseal CIDR.
frank: here's a sample preflight script snippet:
```
curl -sfS https://10.8.20.5:8200/v1/sys/health || exit 1
kubectl -n priv-keystore exec audit-forwarder -- curl -sfS https://retention.internal/health || exit 1
kubectl -n priv-keystore run smoke --image=alpine --rm -- curl -sfS https://10.8.20.5:8200/v1/sys/health || exit 1
```
anya: add a final assert: `vault policy read keystore-breakglass` and diff against expected policy fingerprint. If mismatch, abort and create `migration:failed` event.
sarah: from compliance perspective, we want a pre/post audit record: migration job should write an immutable migration-audit entry with before/after policy hashes and affected serviceaccounts. Store to secure-bucket.
lee: good point. Also we should prevent automated failover from using long-lived breakglass tokens. Failover flows must use ephemeral tokens minted with `wrap_info` and short TTLs.
frank: implement guardrail in CI: before starting rolling restart, CI queries `sum(migration_heartbeat==1) by (node)` and expects equal to node count in rollout batch. If not, fail fast.
anya: network team: please add an allowlist for migration controlplane so migration pod traffic to vault-unseal uses dedicated path, and emit `migration_connectivity` metric.
netbot: will add canary netpol to one node and run heartbeat probe for 15m. If stable, templated netpol will be added to migration job config.
auditor-bot: suggest alert rule: `increase_alert_if(count_over_time(vault_policy_mismatch[5m])>0)` and `vault_breakglass_usage` threshold of >3 in 10m to trigger paged incident.
sarah: also require retention extension: when a migration touching breakglass roles runs, retention for related tenant audit logs must be bumped to 90d for forensic window.
lee: follow-up tasks: Frank to add heartbeat metric+preflight, Anya to update migration job to emit policy hashes, NetEng to deploy canary netpol, Sarah to update compliance runbook. Target: ship guardrail next week.
frank: I'll open a tiny RFC and draft PR for the heartbeat exporter. I'll also add a migration retry backoff so we don't trigger automated rolling restarts repeatedly.
anya: thumbs-up. once canary proves healthy, we'll gate full cluster migration and schedule a short maintenance window. Closing thread when PR merged and canary green.
